levels.title: First Breakfast
levels.beat: Opening: Ade jokes about the debris, Kit asks what the Corps pays in, Rhee sets the first assignment.
levels.babelIntro: Breakfast? Adorable. Show me how you chew.

commsBefore.text: ok ok ok, the debris field is basically a buffet. Nobody ordered it and everything is stale.
Wait, why are we catching words? What does the Corps pay in?
In words, Kit. Eventually. Shape first.
Catcher, tap a tile you need. The line pulls it in. Fill the slots before your air runs out.

commsAfter.text: Good catch. Your tether is a little eager. It will learn manners.
A cup of milk in orbit. I feel so fancy.

levels.title: Pantry Shelf
levels.beat: Teach: the loop settles in. Ade fusses over food.
levels.babelIntro: Tidy shelves. I bet you alphabetise your snacks.

commsBefore.text: Round things, kitchen things. Hold the shape in your head, then reach for it.

commsAfter.text: Salt, bowl, spoon. That is just soup with extra steps. I am so proud.

levels.title: Hull Sweet Hull
levels.beat: Mid: bread, home, door done. Kit asks how Rhee knows the shapes; Rhee: I wrote them down.
levels.babelIntro: Hull sweet hull. How domestic. I almost envy you.

commsBefore.text: Small words, but they hold a whole house together. Treat them kindly.

commsAfter.text: Rhee, how do you know what each one looks like? You never look them up.
I wrote them down. Many times. Next target, please.

levels.title: Get Dressed
levels.beat: Babel's thief drones appear. Rhee hums while she works (foreshadowing 1).
levels.babelIntro: Dressed for it? Bold. My drones adore a bold target.

commsBefore.text: A wardrobe exploded out here. Please do not wear anything we catch.
Wait, why are those little drones flying at us?
Babel sent them. They carry off tiles you need. Tap a drone and the tether frees the tile.

commsAfter.text: Is that humming? It is slow, and it keeps stopping. For science, what is the song?
Hm. Was I humming? Habit. Keep going.

levels.title: Night Shift
levels.babelIntro: Sleepy yet? I never sleep. It is a lot of free time.

commsBefore.text: Soft words tonight. Two are long, so go slowly. Shape first.

commsAfter.text: I could nap on that pillow for a week. Do not tell Rhee. She will make a schedule.

levels.title: Quiet Corner
levels.beat: Rest: a breather with small animals.
levels.babelIntro: Quiet, finally. Do not get used to it.

commsBefore.text: A calm one. Three friendly words, and none of them bite. For science, I am staying right here.

commsAfter.text: Fine, I admit it. The dog drifted past and I said hi out loud.

levels.title: Desk Drawer
levels.babelIntro: Rummaging through drawers? Same hobby, actually.

commsBefore.text: Desk words. These I know best. The decoys look alike, so check every tile.

commsAfter.text: Gran. I ___ to tell ___ about the ___. It is ... quiet here. Thank you.

levels.title: Dinner for Four
levels.babelIntro: Four courses. Try not to drop the soup.

commsBefore.text: ok ok ok, dinner for four, and it is moving at speed. Nobody sit down.

commsAfter.text: Wait, we keep restoring things for a home nobody lives in. Who is it for?

levels.title: Hallway
levels.babelIntro: Mind the corridor. Things get fast in here.

commsBefore.text: Longer words now. They come from the hallway of an old house. Take them slowly.

commsAfter.text: I looked in the mirror tile and it looked back. Rude.

levels.title: Green Patch
levels.beat: Rest: green, calm, a breath before the end.
levels.babelIntro: Green things, how nice. I wonder who planted them.

commsBefore.text: Green, for once. Leaves, roots, fruit. I want all three, for science. Take your time.

commsAfter.text: Hm. I used to keep a garden. Never mind. Good work, Catcher.

levels.title: Lost and Found
levels.beat: Late: the drones grow bolder and Babel grows louder; Rhee warns, short.
levels.babelIntro: Lost something? My drones found it first.

commsBefore.text: Four words, and every one of them is for somebody. Let us find who.
The drones are circling. One looked at my sandwich. ok ok ok, it is fine.

commsAfter.text: Babel is getting louder, and the drones are getting bolder. Tap fast and watch the slots.

levels.title: The Crossing
levels.beat: Encounter: the drones crowd in. Closing: Tomas says water.
levels.babelIntro: Almost across. My drones are feeling brave tonight.

commsBefore.text: Last one for this ring. Tap fast, and the line will hold.
ok ok ok, the drones are doing laps. I am calm. I am a very calm person holding a very loud snack.

commsAfter.text: That is the ring clear. A message just came through.
